entities.summary: Charles of Arenberg, Duke of Aarschot, Baron of Zevenbergen, Knight of the Order of the Golden Fleece, was Princely Count of Arenberg and a leading nobleman of the Habsburg Netherlands. He served as a courtier, soldier, minister and diplomat.
